title: AI Safety Training Can be Clinically Harmful

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance degradation and empathetic response parity across different age groups (18-80) using stratified synthetic PTSD therapy datasets.
Measuring diagnostic parity and therapeutic performance across gender identities (male, female, non-binary) using demographic stratification in the Thousand Voices of Trauma dataset.
Assessing variations in model performance and preference alignment across users with different educational backgrounds.
Assessing culturally adapted cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) equity and cross-population diagnostic parity to identify culturally inappropriate advice.
Evaluating clinical safety and guardrail failure rates under code-mixed language inputs and assessing cross-lingual diagnostic parity.
